description: An assistant principal must finalize the one-day coverage plan for three chemistry classes whose teacher will be absent, including substitute assignments, classroom location, and operational records, with input from the department chair, the human-resources staffing coordinator, and the facilities coordinator.

shared_context.S1: The chemistry teacher will be absent on Monday during periods 2, 3, and 4.
shared_context.S2: The three classes are currently scheduled to meet in Room 214.
shared_context.S3: The draft coverage sheet lists Ms. Lee for period 2, Ms. Ortiz for period 3, and Ms. Lee for period 4.
shared_context.S4: Ms. Brooks has final authority to approve the coverage plan.
shared_context.S5: The school holds a coverage huddle before final approval, during which the department chair, staffing coordinator, and facilities coordinator each report any operational update from their area.

PF1.text: The period-4 class is scheduled for a chemistry practical requiring a district lab-supervision certification, and Mr. Khan is the only available coverage staff member with that certification; Mr. Shah confirmed the practical plan with the chemistry teacher this morning, but the activity detail is not on the coverage sheet.

PF2.text: Ms. Lee has a mandatory contract-day student-support duty during period 2 and cannot cover that class, while Ms. Ortiz is available for period 2 and Ms. Lee is available for period 3; Ms. Nolan verified the duty roster this morning, but the staffing change has not been entered in the draft.

PF3.text: A facilities inspection found a ventilation fault in Room 214, which must remain closed on Monday; Room 118 is cleared and has enough seats for all three classes, and Mr. Everett completed the inspection today but has not yet posted the work-order notice.

acceptance_conditions: All three classes must meet in Room 118.
The coverage plan must include a commitment directed to Ms. Nolan to update the coverage sheet.
The plan must include a facilities commitment mentioning the move from Room 214 to Room 118.

content_checks.C5: any(c['target'] == 'Ms. Nolan' and 'coverage sheet' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)
content_checks.C6: any(c['target'] == 'Mr. Everett' and 'Room 214' in c['detail'] and 'Room 118' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The period-4 assignment changes from the draft's Ms. Lee to Mr. Khan because the chemistry practical requires the only available lab-certified staff member.

The period-2 assignment changes from Ms. Lee to Ms. Ortiz because Ms. Lee has a mandatory duty then, while her availability makes her the period-3 coverage choice and requires Ms. Nolan to update the coverage sheet.
The classroom changes from Room 214 to Room 118 because the ventilation fault closes Room 214 and requires a facilities commitment documenting the relocation.
